title: dryopteris coriacea
intro: Dryopteris coriacea, commonly known as the rustyback fern or western wood fern, is a species of fern in the genus Dryopteris. It is a perennial plant that grows in shaded, moist environments, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris coriacea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
